instruction: I want to set my current time zone to Asia/Dubai. Can you help me?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting timezone to Asia/Dubai. Evaluator checks timedatectl output for correct timezone string. Verified by checking timedatectl output format: line with 'Time zone:' contains timezone pattern.
